dct_description_sm: Appears in: The Second Booke. The true and perfect description of the whole of Guinea, Manicongo, Angola, Monomotapa ... (1598) (English edition)
This map is an English translation of Johan Huygen van Linschoten's Relatione de Reame di Congo.

Norwich, I., Pam Kolbe, and Jeffrey C Stone. Norwich's Maps of Africa: An Illustrated and Annotated Carto-Bibliography. 2nd ed. / rev. and edited by Jeffrey C. Stone. Norwich, Vt.: Terra Nova Press, 1997, map 0293, p. 333
David Rumsey Map Center copy 1: Norwich no. NOR 0293.
